title: Prepare manual Space email domain onboarding with tenant-bound DNS ownership proof
detail:
Owner setup implementation remains draft until database and integrated pilot proof. Registered Studio email-domain fields render through FieldControl on the existing Email settings surface; authenticated server actions prepare a persisted operation and Space/owner/domain/op-ID/random-nonce signed TXT proof. Manual provider-issued DNS records, retry/proof refresh, provider verification check, sender/default selection and explicit Frequency reset are available. Durable service-only operation lease prevents concurrent/retried provider creation; provider-success/registry-failure replays saved provider identity; timeout recovery reconciles provider list instead of blind create. Purpose defaults use composite tenant FK; fresh worker default resolver snapshots identity for future messages while queued custom selections retain their original identity. Existing paid capability reconciliation still requires authorized resolver rollout; capability is not loosened. Receiving is explicitly disconnected and separately gated; no automatic DNS or apex MX change. SQL/RLS/default/lease replay and complete actual setup-to-send/reply proof remain unverified. No live DB, provider, DNS, send or deployment mutations performed.

META-SCAN 2026-10-12. Migration 20270346007800 is applied in production. An operation-bound ownership proof is now stable per setup and does not expire (it was a one-hour token, so slow DNS forced a new TXT value on every refresh). Member help: content/help/spaces/email-domain.md. Live posture read 2026-10-12 (read-only SQL): RLS on for all eight email tables; email_delivery_intents, email_provider_attempts, space_email_domain_operations, space_email_reply_aliases and space_email_reply_quarantine grant nothing to anon or authenticated and carry no policy (service only); space_email_domains, space_email_identities and space_email_identity_defaults are SELECT-only for authenticated under one policy each; enqueue_conversation_email_intent, prepare/settle/read_accepted_email_provider_attempt and claim_space_email_domain_operation execute for service_role only.

verify.evidence: Application fixture tests cover owner/TXT refusal before provider create, persistence recovery without second create, ambiguous acceptance reconciliation, busy leases, signed operation-ID/nonce mismatch, manifest validation and free/paid settings presentation. Tree grant/function/FK/migration checks run separately; 8 new pgTAP behavior assertions authored but NOT EXECUTED (database unavailable). Keep OPEN until migration replay/RLS/service-lease proof, browser wizard review and owner-triggered authenticated sending/reply path pass; receiving activation remains a separate gate.
